step_by_step_approach: Collect all match records for every season within each league.
For each match, determine which side won by comparing the home and away goal counts.
Assign a win to the team that scored more goals; record no win for a draw.
Count the total wins for each team across all matches in its league.
Include teams that have zero wins in the count.
Identify the smallest win total for each league.
From the teams tied at that smallest total, pick one team per league.
Return each league together with the selected team's name and its win total.
